Tiling

A detail you live with every day.

On floors or walls, tiling brings materials, light and everyday use together. A choice to consider for both its appearance and the way you live.

Discuss your building project

One material. A sense of balance.

The substrate, tile format, laying pattern and joints all shape the result. We discuss your room’s requirements and the finishes you have in mind before defining the works.

  • Floor tile installation
  • Wall tiling and ceramic finishes
  • Substrate preparation
  • Grouting and finishing

The feasibility, scope and conditions of the works will be defined after your project has been assessed.

Before
you begin.

Does the existing tiling need to be removed?+

The condition and adhesion of the existing surface, along with the available height, need to be assessed. The appropriate solution is determined after inspecting what is already there.

Can I choose my own tiles?+

Show us the finish and tile format you have in mind. We can discuss how they suit the substrate and the requirements of your room.
